header: Pilotwings 64's extended plan for N64Recomp-browser's tools/play_page.mjs, at most 5 minutes with every timeout
counted, for when a longer play than the regular one (tools/play_plan.json) is needed: the launcher, Load ROM once the
shader list Chrome builds behind it is done (a click while it builds is lost, and the game never starts; Firefox
builds none there, and its line saying so is the one waited for), the title, then tests started as a player starts
them, through the menus (tools/shader_survey.js's go(), which presses Start and A and writes the vehicle and class at
the pilot select, a need that fails the run unless that vehicle and class are flying): the hang glider's first
Beginner test flown 12 s and the skydive's first B test (Ever-Frost Island) 20 s, each ended through its results by
land(), then the gyrocopter's first B test (Little States) 25 s. The gyrocopter comes last: its test runs on its own
clock, which land()'s presses of A don't end, and the cannonball's goes on to its next target. Each vehicle is flown
by holding keys for so many ms of the browser's time. The skydiver is down about a minute after the jump, so its
land() has 80 s and the other steps' limits are what they take with room to spare.
